A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] was the '''Huntmaster''' of the third [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[Time/Legends|time]] of heated tension between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:TH" /> He won the third hunt, which happened during the [[Great Galactic War]], and  eventually accepted [[Mandalore the Vindicated]]'s offer to become Huntmaster of the Great Hunt. Though expected to be Mandalorian, the Mandalore can present any worthy warrior to such a position.
